mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscriptions WHERE status = #{status}

SELECT s.id AS subscription_id, s.store_id, p.code AS plan, s.status AS subscription_status, s.started_at, s.next_billing_at, latest.status AS latest_payment_status FROM subscriptions s INNER JOIN plans p ON p.id = s.plan_id LEFT JOIN payments latest ON latest.id = ( SELECT candidate.id FROM payments candidate WHERE candidate.subscription_id = s.id ORDER BY candidate.created_at DESC, candidate.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
